scope: Explicit complete-serving RND replacement filters and recorded no-suitable-replacement rejection

database.externalProviders: disabled; acceptance network restricted to loopback

checks: Full-catalog search finds a zero-valued candidate beyond row 120, excludes unknown and unverified values, includes rice and enforces role/claim
Authoritative post-policy counts and all pages include every eligible result without duplicate rows
Fixed-unit numeric boundaries and missing required side values fail closed
Quarantine and expired recipe-verifier credentials cannot be bypassed by a previously filtered choice
Final swap rechecks filters, extended base values and side composition even when the recipe signature stays unchanged
Expired credentials fail; concurrent swaps publish one exact composed serving which still needs separate approval
A context-bound signed search and comprehensive rationale record no suitable replacement, retain the rejected slot and stop fallback/provider calls
Slot holds also block deadline, certified, raw and AI replacement paths for competing rows
An exhausted search records zero matches separately from clinical rejection of remaining numeric matches
Case-scoped admin oversight shows saved filters, counts, rationale and reviewed context and records sensitive access
Outdated meal context cannot commit a search outcome or resurrect a stale decision

cases: role, claim and eligible preview filters
tampered and ineligible replacements are rejected
one atomic pending replacement under concurrent submissions, preserved claim, no approval or notification, audit and stale groceries
deadline fallback cannot approve, replace or cancel a pending RND-selected meal
replacement remains inspectable and only a separate explicit decision approves it
changed source cannot publish a replacement
expired claim cannot publish a replacement
changed member safety cannot publish a replacement
changed replacement evidence cannot publish a replacement
quarantine hold is rechecked inside transaction
existing automatic certified fallback still works
past, ended, completed and replaced requests leave active queues and counts with routing on/off; today/future cases remain
stale previews, claims, approvals, rejections, swaps and dispute approvals are blocked; today remains claimable
history and snapshots are retained with admin related-case oversight; active-queue retirement deletes no data
heart specialists, experienced generalists and new RNDs see the same cases and profiles despite legacy priority; claims, roles, notifications and historical audit remain protected

limits: Filter scope is currently eligible certified-library candidates; no AI, universal clinical thresholds or broadened condition clearance.
Signed search counts describe the recorded search, not proof that every numeric match was clinically inspected.
Shared rollout, authenticated browser E2E, reusable summaries and remaining-date log/purchase reconciliation remain pending.
These software checks do not establish clinical validation.
